verses.exactText: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

verses.exactText: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

verses.exactText: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

verses.exactText: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

verses.exactText: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

verses.exactText: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

verses.exactText: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

verses.exactText: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

verses.exactText: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

verses.exactText: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

verses.exactText: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

verses.exactText: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

verses.exactText: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

verses.exactText: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

verses.exactText: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

verses.exactText: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

verses.exactText: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

verses.exactText: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

verses.exactText: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

verses.exactText: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

verses.exactText: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

verses.exactText: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

verses.exactText: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

verses.exactText: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.

verses.exactText: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

verses.exactText: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

verses.exactText: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

verses.exactText: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

verses.exactText: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

verses.exactText: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

verses.exactText: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

verses.exactText: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

verses.exactText: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

verses.exactText: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

verses.exactText: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

verses.exactText: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

verses.exactText: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

verses.exactText: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:
verses.normalizedComparisonText: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

verses.exactText: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

verses.exactText: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

verses.exactText: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

verses.exactText: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

verses.exactText: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

verses.exactText: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

verses.exactText: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.

verses.exactText: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?
verses.normalizedComparisonText: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

verses.exactText: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

verses.exactText: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

verses.exactText: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

verses.exactText: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

verses.exactText: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

verses.exactText: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.

verses.exactText: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

verses.exactText: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”

verses.exactText: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.

verses.exactText: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.

verses.exactText: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.

verses.exactText: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”

verses.exactText: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?

verses.exactText: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

verses.exactText: The same was in the beginning with God.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The same was in the beginning with God.

verses.exactText: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

verses.exactText: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

verses.exactText: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

verses.exactText: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

verses.exactText: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

verses.exactText: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

verses.exactText: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

verses.exactText: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

verses.exactText: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

verses.exactText: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:
verses.normalizedComparisonText: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

verses.exactText: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

verses.exactText: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

verses.exactText: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

verses.exactText: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

verses.exactText: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

verses.exactText: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

verses.exactText: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

verses.exactText: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

verses.exactText: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

verses.exactText: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

verses.exactText: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

verses.exactText: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

verses.exactText: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

verses.exactText: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

verses.exactText: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

verses.exactText: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

verses.exactText: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

verses.exactText: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’
verses.normalizedComparisonText: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

verses.exactText: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

verses.exactText: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

verses.exactText: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

verses.exactText: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

verses.exactText: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

verses.exactText: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

verses.exactText: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

verses.exactText: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

verses.exactText: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

verses.exactText: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

verses.exactText: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

verses.exactText: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

verses.exactText: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

verses.exactText: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

verses.exactText: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

verses.exactText: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

verses.exactText: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

verses.exactText: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

verses.exactText: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

verses.exactText: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

verses.exactText: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
verses.normalizedComparisonText: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”
